summary_en: ASTERIA Corporation raised its FY2027 year-end dividend forecast from 10 yen to 11 yen per share, reflecting solid interim results and improved earnings outlook.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, ASTERIA Corporation's Board of Directors approved a revision to the year-end dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company increased the year-end dividend per share from the previously announced 10 yen to 11 yen, representing a 1 yen increase.

The company stated that the revision reflects solid performance through the second quarter of fiscal 2027 and a comprehensive assessment of future business outlook. The interim dividend remains unchanged at 10 yen per share, bringing the total annual dividend to 21 yen, compared to the previous forecast of 20 yen. The prior year (fiscal 2026) dividend was 9 yen for the year-end.

The final amount of the year-end dividend will be confirmed by the Board of Directors meeting scheduled for May 2027.
